en: Oh! Someone's here! I've been wandering in the dark for ever so long. Are you real?
Prove it! Battle me, and then I'll know I'm not dreaming.
You're real, and you're strong too! Please, would you take me home? I'm sure I'll only get lost again on my own.
{player} led Selphy out of the Lost Cave and back to Resort Gorgeous.
Which way is out? Every room looks the same!
